name: CalcAc
description: Calculated acreage.

name: County
description: Location of the well by county, derived from API for US data.

name: DeletedDate
requirements: Value should be in the RFC3339 format. Example: 2021-01-01
description: Date the record was deleted.

name: ENVBasin
description: ENV Basin as defined by a well's location within one of 32 ENV Basin Shapefiles. Basins are defined by EIA Shapefiles and Enverus-defined geological prospectivity.

name: ENVOperator
description: The name of the operator as it appears in Prism.

name: ENVPeerGroup
description: The respective group a company belongs based on market capitalization for public companies, and for private companies either private equity backed or non-private equity backed private distinctions.

name: ENVPlay
description: The play level intersect removes areas of overlap of operator land to not double count inventory.

name: ENVRegion
description: ENV Region as defined by a well's location within one of nine ENV Region Shapefiles. ENV Region inclusively covers North America.

name: ENVSubPlay
description: ENV Sub Play as defined by a well's location within an Enverus-defined Sub Play Shapefile. Sub Play is a subset of a play where all Sub Plays inclusively make up a play.

name: ENVTicker
description: Ticker symbol for the most recent reported operator based on Enverus-normalized ENV Operator field. Public companies follow the convention of "-US" for US-listed stocks and "-CA" for Canadian-listed stocks. Private operators are followed by an asterisk*.

name: EstimatedNetAcreage_AC
description: Weighted net acreage estimate of a single record based on the disclosed values.

name: EstWorkingInterest_PCT
description: Disclosed or calculated working interest of the entire operator region.

name: Geom_Poly
description: Geometry of operator land.

name: GeomBBox_Poly
description: Geometry of bounding box.

name: OperatorRegion
description: Operator region.

name: OpNonOp
description: Calculated op/non-op acreage.

name: OpRegGross
description: Disclosed or calculated gross acreage within the entire operator region.

name: OpRegNet
description: Disclosed or calculated net acreage within the entire operator region.

name: PECompanyWideEquityCommitment_MM
description: The total equity PE Sponsor Committed.

name: PEInitialFundingYear
description: Year of initial PE funding.

name: PESponsors
description: The name of the PE Sponsors who are backing companies.

name: PEStatus
description: Current PE status.

name: PETargetRegion
description: The targeted region.

name: RAWOperator
description: The most recently reported operator obtained from the state document, permit, completion or production data source.

name: Reg_PCT
description: Operator region percentage in the play acreage position.

name: ShapefileUpdateDate
description: Date the shape file was updated.

name: SPOpReg_PCT
description: Estimated net acreage percentage of the entire play.

name: StateProvince
description: Location of the well by country, derived from API for US data.

name: TOpRegNet
description: Disclosed or calculated net acreage within the entire play.

name: UpdatedDate
requirements: Value should be in the RFC3339 format. Example: 2021-01-01
description: Date the record was updated.

name: UniqueID
description: Enverus generated unique operator land ID.
